$comment: Desired Aphrody shared data contract, owner request 2026-10-09. Inert declaration: no database/schema/host creation or SQLite migration is activated by this file.

shared.profileIsolation: separate credentials and databases or schemas with enforced grants; never a caller-supplied profile alone
shared.migrationPolicy: checksummed additive migrations and advisory lock through aphrody-sql

authentication.contract: one contract per public origin shared by web and desktop
authentication.oauthRedirects: exact registered origins; native PKCE/browser handoff requires provider-specific qualification
authentication.providerTokens: protected auth schema/store only; never retrieval, graph, catalog or training payloads
authentication.email: verified mail transport required before activation

cache.role: derived cache, session acceleration and invalidation only
cache.restartBehavior: rebuild from durable SQL/outbox; cache outage must not erase source state
cache.invalidation: SQL transaction writes version and outbox; publish only after commit, reconcile missed events

gates: dry-run row counts and content hashes
